jobPostingInfo.title: Software Engineering Intern (Summer 2027)
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
U.S. Person Status:

This job requires a U.S. Person. U.S. citizens, U.S. permanent residents, refugees, and asylees are considered U.S. persons.

What You Will Do:

  • Develop and test flight-control software.

Qualifications You Must Have:

  • Must be pursuing a Bachelor’s or Advanced degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field and actively enrolled through completion of the internship.
  • Must have a minimum of 90 credit hours by the start of the internship.
  • Experience using C and Python.

Qualifications We Prefer:

  • Experience using Git.
  • Strong communication skills.
